name: Los Angeles 1985
source: “Los Angeles 1985” is an anthology yuri romance kinetic novel. Follow in the steps of four women in Los Angeles in 1985 as they live through the fast-paced glamour of the 1980s and explore both themselves, the City of Angels and go through a voyage in lesbian love. Follow four loveable ladies in two thoughtful and heartwarming tales about finding love when you least expect it!
translation: 《洛杉矶1985》是一部选集尤里浪漫动感小说。追随1985年洛杉矶四位女性的脚步，体验20世纪80年代快节奏的魅力，探索她们自己，这座天使之城，经历一场女同性恋爱情之旅。跟随四位可爱的女士讲述两个深思熟虑且温馨的故事，讲述在你最意想不到的时候寻找爱情的故事！
